description: An encoding of a sound: another file with the same audio

mime_type.description: type/subtype (RFC 6838), without parameters, e.g. audio/mpeg, audio/wav, audio/vnd.cochlea.sprs+json

metadata.description: Anything about the encoding (at most 16 KB): sample_rate, channels, bit_depth, bitrate... Suggested keys per type are in docs/sound-formats.md.
